notes.title: Time Flies is about a bug finding god or learning guitar in something like 76.4 seconds, and it's got a release date
notes.notes:
Bzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz. Time Flies, the latest wonderfully weird game from Swiss devs Playables, will turn you into a fly. I mean, the clue was in the name. You live for a matter of seconds every playthrough, and in that time, you've got a bug bucket list of stuff you can do.
You'd better not screw around. Or you'd better get on with screwing around. Either way, this cool cousin/sibling to the equally bizarre Kids and My Exercise is coming out on PC July 31st.
 Read more

notes.title: 📅 RELEASE DATE - Time Flies is coming July 31st
notes.notes:
Hello! A bit since you have heard from us, but Time Flies is coming July 31st! 

[previewyoutube="FzAwgAIXn28;full"][/previewyoutube]
 

Flies are pretty annoying, and we’ve been listening to one every day for the past four years of game development.  Please do your part and Wishlist the game now, I really need therapy. 👍



Thank you and see you on July 31st  

-Michael Frei @ Playables
